author: @gilliancookstudio

title: Completely useless without a subscription—major paywall trap
body:
Don’t waste your time downloading this if you are looking for a free scheduling tool. They market it as a visual planner, but they lock the most basic, non-negotiable features behind a subscription wall.
You cannot repeat a task across multiple days. You cannot copy a day's schedule. You can't even duplicate a basic routine without being prompted to buy the premium version. The built-in AI assistant completely freezes or goes blank if you try to give it a standard calendar prompt, making it completely pointless.
Forcing users to manually type out every single task from scratch every single day just because they don't want to pay a subscription is ridiculous. There are plenty of other calendar and timeline apps out there that let you use basic repeat and copy functions for free. Skip this one.
